summary: Iter-19 / Phase-3 — All 3 ported features verified end-to-end after rebuild. (1) Multi-store cart max=2 rule enforced with exact toast wording. (2) Inline size strip on ProductCardV2 (`Select size` → pills → add). (3) Merchant Online/Offline toggle in sidebar flips state, shows sonner toast, persists via POST /api/merchant/store/online. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass. CRITICAL: the deployed .next bundle was 35 min stale vs source edits — testing agent triggered `yarn build` + `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` to surface the iter-44 code; without that step ALL 3 features were silently broken in the preview URL.

issues: The dashboard main content area renders nearly empty/black under the Menscape header in the screenshot — only the 'Welcome back, Menscape' line and 'Open AI Studio' button are visible. Unrelated to iter-44 but worth flagging for the next dashboard polish pass.

action_items: CI/Deploy: ensure `yarn build` runs after every iter source change before users hit the preview — iter-44 features were entirely invisible in the production bundle until I rebuilt. Consider switching the supervisor frontend to `next dev` for the preview env, or adding a post-edit build hook so source-only fixes don't appear deployed when they aren't.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductCardV2.handleAdd correctly reveals the inline strip for sizes.length>1, but the toast wording is hardcoded with `&` join — if a future cart-limit raise to MAX=3 ships, the join('& ') produces `A & B & C` which reads oddly. Use a small `formatList` helper.

OnlineToggle.tsx calls api.merchant.storeState() once on mount and never re-syncs; if the merchant pauses/unpauses elsewhere or admin flips them, the in-component state is stale until full page reload. Consider re-fetching on window focus or after each flip.

Backend POST /api/merchant/store/online accepts a raw dict; missing `online` key silently coerces to False (verified in test). This is benign today but should use Pydantic so junk payloads don't accidentally take merchants offline.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 3 iter-44 features (cart max-2, inline size strip, merchant online toggle) after rebuild

test_credentials: Demo merchant menscape@lokl.demo / Demo@2026 (approved + published, 13 products, can_toggle=true) verified live.
seed_data_creation: No new seed run required — demo merchants already present from prior iter18 seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is served by `next start` (production bundle from /app/frontend/.next). When iter source files change, you MUST run `cd /app/frontend && yarn build && sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` before testing — hot-reload is NOT in effect. Test products with multiple stores+sizes on home feed: prod-demo-3125435a (Anjali, sizes [S,M,L,XL]), prod-demo-8a42708e (Menscape, multi-size), prod-a91fa50d8b (Iter5 ImgStore ec9a, multi-size). For single-size add-immediate testing use prod-73c10b0eeb (Menscape, sizes []). Merchant store/state endpoint contract: {published, online, paused, product_count, can_toggle}.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial test run failed every iter-44 assertion: home card showed 'Add' label (legacy) and silently added sizes[0] to cart on click, no inline strip rendered. Root cause: /app/frontend/.next/BUILD_ID stamped 23:33 UTC while /app/frontend/src/components/consumer/v2/ProductCardV2.tsx + cart.store.ts + OnlineToggle.tsx were last modified at 00:08-00:09 UTC (~35 min AFTER the build). Since the supervisor runs `next start` (production), the preview URL was serving a pre-iter-44 chunk. Mitigation applied: ran `yarn build` (29.76 s, success) then `supervisorctl restart frontend`; re-ran all UI tests and every iter-44 assertion now passes including the verbatim toast wording 'Your bag already has items from Anjali Store & Menscape. Lokl allows up to 2 stores per order.' Action for the main agent: codify a build-on-edit hook or switch the preview to next dev for the cutover period.
